findings.title: P3 secret detector is narrower than the scope's own forbidden classes (false-null)
findings.detail: index_health.sh SECRET regex covers only ^.env(.|$), .jks/.keystore/.p12/.pfx and 'secret' in a basename. config/index/scope.yaml forbidden_classes also forbid *.pem, *.key, *.pk8, *.env (e.g. prod.env), and secrets/ directories. Probe (fixture, scratch): a/localhost.key, a/dhparams.pem, a/prod.env, a/secrets/db.yaml each give P3=PASS; control a/release.jks gives P3=FAIL (instrument sees). Real files of these classes exist in the tree (git ls-files --recurse-submodules: helix_qa/tools/opensource/.../localhost.key, dhparams.pem, example.env, ...-creds.env). The current codegraph files capture holds 0 of them (control needle catalog-api/main.go present), so no live leak, but the gate cannot detect one. Fix: derive P3's classes from scope.yaml forbidden_classes (one class source) with their positive/negative fixtures.

findings.title: Reviewer-authored mutations survive both index_health test suites
findings.detail: Five mutations not in mutate_index_health.sh survive test_index_health.sh (13/13) AND test_index_health_extra.sh (54/54): M1 drop the reindexRecommended check; M2 drop pendingChanges.{added,modified,removed} nonzero check; M3 drop captured_time_unparseable; M6 drop .jks/.keystore/.p12/.pfx from SECRET; M8 own-org root prefix boundary removed (startswith(r) instead of r+'/'). M2 is load-bearing: it is the exact reason P1 FAILs on the real run (pendingChanges.added/modified_nonzero), yet no test proves it. Per 11.4.194(6)(d)/11.4.235(D) the gate is not proven-correct until each has a RED case. M7 (accept state 'indexing') was caught (M5-3).

findings.title: Gate exits 0 (verdict PASS) while proofs are SKIP; P4/P5/P6 are SKIP unconditionally
findings.detail: verdict is PASS whenever no proof FAILs; P4, P5, P6 are hard-coded SKIP and P8 SKIPs without --lumen-files, so the best reachable result is rc=0 with complete=false. A caller reading the exit code (11.4.135 'absence of a verdict blocks as FAIL', 11.4.236) gets a green for an unproven index. T025 acceptance 'P1 to P8 PASS' is therefore structurally unreachable. Fix: a distinct exit code (or verdict INCOMPLETE) when any SKIP exists, plus a tracked plan for where P4/P5/P6 are proven; or amend T021/T025 text with an owner decision.

findings.title: Committed lumen_scope.json cannot be re-derived by its own tool from committed inputs
findings.detail: scope_to_lumen_json.py --scope config/index/scope.yaml --submodules-tsv audit/submodules.tsv --check config/index/lumen_scope.json exits 1 with 33 'allow entry not derived (extra)' (catalog-api, catalog-web, docs, ...). Re-derivation with --out gives allow 50 vs committed 83 (deny/classes/dropped_negations equal). It passes (rc=0) only with the out-of-tool recipe in audit/index-scope-notes.md that merges config/index/lumen_allow_roots.yaml into a scratch YAML (F-INDEX-009, OWED-T019-1). A derivation that needs a hand-run python one-liner is not 'ONLY through the tool' (T019) and is a 11.4.274 extraction gap; a naive re-run would deny the whole main application from Lumen. Fix: add --allow-roots FILE (or read lumen_allow_roots.yaml) to scope_to_lumen_json.py with a test, and make --check part of the gate.

findings.title: .lumenignore already stale versus the tree; no freshness check exists
findings.detail: gen_lumenignore.py over the committed lumen_scope.json now emits 5 deny lines the committed .lumenignore lacks: /.helix/ (tracked .helix/reporting.yaml added 58cb30b8 today, not ignored), /coverage/, /reports/, /prev3/, /catalogizer-test-zzsw10647std/. The allow-list generator enumerates top-level dirs present at render time, so a new top-level dir is neither allowed nor denied until re-render, and nothing in WP-02 detects that. Fix: a --check mode (render to temp, cmp) wired into index_health or the pre-commit stage.

findings.title: T020: scope negation re-includes build-output paths for CodeGraph
findings.detail: Diff 26755ca5..f04c555d of .gitignore is only the delimited helix-codegraph-scope block (as required). git check-ignore (scratch repos, old vs new .gitignore): submodules/doc_processor/pkg/coverage/{coverage.html,lcov.info,coverage.xml,index.html} were ignored by root rule 'coverage/' (line 139) and are no longer; coverage.out stays ignored; .env, *.key, google-services.json, layout/build/x.bin stay ignored under every negated tree (controls). Git effect is nil (paths lie inside a submodule, whose own .gitignore ignores coverage.out/coverage.html), but CodeGraph reads the root .gitignore, so generated coverage reports in that tree would enter the index. Fix: negate only the source files (e.g. /submodules/doc_processor/pkg/coverage/*.go) or add a re-exclusion of report extensions after the negation.

findings.title: T016/T021 text promises a lumen search probe that the gate deliberately refuses
findings.detail: index_health.sh fails P-Lumen on --lumen-bin with reason probe_not_run_read_only_gate_needs_status_capture because a lumen search writes the index (EnsureFresh). The reasoning is sound, but tasks.md T016/T021 still describe the probe path as a way to derive P-Lumen; amend the task text (or record the decision) so the contract and the code agree. Also P7 checks only that Captured: parses, never its age or a HEAD fingerprint, so an old 'Stale: no' capture passes P7.

findings.title: test_scope_to_lumen_json.sh depends on the real repository layout
findings.detail: In a scratch git repo without submodules/constitution and with no commit, the gen_lumenignore leg fails (rc=2) and the IDENTITY line prints a git error; in the real repository it is 60/60. Fine for its purpose, but the test should SKIP-with-reason rather than FAIL when the generator is absent, and handle an unborn HEAD.
